reviews.title: Way Better Than Expected — This Was a Steal
reviews.comment: Honestly blown away by this deal. The seller shipped fast, the packaging was great, and the drive looked brand new. I dropped it into my Alienware 18 Area-51 and ran benchmarks right away. CrystalDiskMark shows full Gen4 speeds, and CrystalDiskInfo reports only 155 GB written and 7 power‑on counts. That’s basically untouched. Temps are around 50°C right now, and I’ll shave off another 10–15°C once my Alienware thermal pad/bracket kit shows up. With how crazy NVMe prices are right now (most 2TB Gen4 drives are $300+), getting one in this condition for this price feels like winning the lottery. Fantastic seller — would absolutely buy from again.
reviews.author: Tyler
